title: ScorpionAI Atlas Dataset Dictionary & Schema Specification

entities.name: Mature Peptides
entities.inclusion_criteria: Scorpion-derived peptide sequences without ambiguous characters, with verified mature sequence cleavage and known species origin.
entities.exclusion_criteria: Non-scorpion sequences, truncated non-functional fragments lacking terminal boundaries, uncurated duplicates.

entities.name: Assay Evidence Rows
entities.inclusion_criteria: Primary literature-reported microdilution assays against bacterial or fungal reference strains under CLSI/EUCAST standards.
entities.exclusion_criteria: Aggregated reviews lacking primary experimental data, qualitative agar-diffusion-only assays without MIC.

entities.name: Prioritized Candidate Cohort
entities.inclusion_criteria: The canonical 20 candidates established and frozen at baseline commit a36050a evaluated across MOD-07 through MOD-11.

entities.name: Sequence Clusters
entities.inclusion_criteria: Single-linkage connected-component clusters generated at 70% pairwise sequence identity threshold to prevent cross-fold evaluation leakage.

entities.name: Literature & Database Sources
entities.inclusion_criteria: Peer-reviewed publications (PMID/DOI) and primary database accessions (UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot) cited across peptide records.
